name: Sarah Chen
text: SimWork completely changed how I showcase my coding skills. The 2.5D environment makes it feel like real work, not just another coding test. I got hired within a week!

name: Marcus Johnson
text: As a designer, I love how SimWork lets me demonstrate my creative process in real-time. The design station tools are incredibly realistic and engaging.

name: Emily Rodriguez
text: The PM scenarios in SimWork are spot-on. It's the first platform that actually tests project management skills in realistic situations. Highly recommended!

name: David Kim
text: The data analysis challenges are incredibly well-designed. SimWork helped me land my dream job by proving my skills in action.

name: Lisa Wang
text: The AI prompt engineering station is brilliant. It's exactly what the industry needs to assess real AI skills beyond theoretical knowledge.

name: Alex Thompson
text: I've tried many coding platforms, but SimWork's immersive approach is unmatched. The gamification makes skill building actually fun!

name: Rachel Green
text: From a hiring perspective, SimWork gives us unprecedented insight into candidates' real abilities. It's revolutionized our recruitment process.

name: James Wilson
text: As a freelancer, SimWork helps me stand out from the crowd. Clients can see my actual work process, not just the end result.
